invskru.desc: A famed claw, the plain scissors katar made into a rare piece: three long slender blades fanned out from one round pivot rivet like the claws of a beast, the middle one the longest, each blade with a small crescent mark etched near its base, set on the H-shaped iron hilt whose two crossbar grips are bound with dark cord. Shown upright, the blade tips at the top, front view, empty, no hand.
invskru.note: round 2: a guide with three blades (round 1 kept two)
invskru.shape: fan-katar: three long thin blades fanned up from one round pivot, the middle one tallest, on the scissors katar's narrow H frame

inv7mas.desc: A famed mace, the plain flanged mace made into a rare piece: its head a round sphere of dark bronze instead of flanges, girdled with three raised rings and rows of round studs, under it a collar shaped like a cup of lotus petals, on a long straight shaft of dark wood bound with bronze rings. Shown upright, head at the top, side view.
inv7mas.note: for Tangun's Instruction: a banded bronze sphere on a lotus collar

invutss.desc: A famed gothic shield, the plain gothic shield made into a rare piece: the tall narrow shield of dark iron bearing at its centre a large fierce horned goblin mask in relief, with bulging eyes, a wide grinning mouth full of teeth and a pair of small horns, two tall curved horns rising from the shield's top corners and two claw hooks curling from its bottom point, a riveted rim. Front view, upright.
invutss.note: for Taibekor's Shining Glory: a goblin mask and horns

invxrss.desc: A famed breastplate, the plain breastplate made into a rare piece, hollow and empty: in the middle of the chest a large heart-shaped dark grey stone set in a raised iron spiral that coils out from it across the chest, the steel dark grey like granite, a high stiff collar, leather shoulder straps and riveted side straps, a short skirt of two lames. Laid flat, front view, empty, no person.
invxrss.note: round 3: a heart-shaped stone in a spiral, big enough to read (round 2's row of spirals was too small)

invuhms.desc: A famed great helm, the plain great helm made into a rare piece, shown empty on its own: the closed iron great helm with its eye slits, crowned by a gilt band from which rise five tall gilt spires branching like stylised trees, small round gilt discs dangling from their branches. Front view.
invuhms.note: for Ondamir's Omnipotence: tree-shaped gilt spires crowning the helm
